result.title: X-Matte: VAE-Free Pixel-Space Flow Matching for Single-Step Image Matting
result.summary: Pre-trained generative models offer rich visual priors for image matting, but their adaptation often relies on variational autoencoders (VAEs), whose spatial compression can degrade fine alpha details and introduce additional inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose X-Matte, a VAE-free pixel-space flow matching framework for single-step image matting. By eliminating latent compression, X-Matte formulates the RGB-to-alpha transition as a continuous flow directly in pixel space. We adopt trajectory-wide x-prediction with transition-aware alpha supervision, enabling the model to learn from intermediate states while directly predicting the target alpha matte in a single forward pass. This design avoids both VAE encoding and decoding and iterative sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate performance competitive with state-of-the-art trimap-free matting methods on P3M benchmarks, together with promising zero-shot generalization to RWP-636 and AIM-500. Moreover, X-Matte achieves up to a 9.4x inference speedup over a constructed single-step latent counterpart at high resolution, demonstrating the effectiveness of VAE-free pixel-space modeling for accurate and efficient image matting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 X-Matte，在像素空间直接做无 VAE 的 flow matching 单步抠图，用轨迹范围 x-prediction 与过渡感知的 alpha 监督从中间状态学习，避免潜空间压缩与迭代采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「中间状态监督 + 单步直接预测」的做法可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 轨迹训练与单步推理，而对 VAE 空间压缩损害细节的讨论也可联系 LVR 中视觉细节保留与信息坍缩问题。
